reports.description:
On 9th Feb 2021, I found out that there was a company that was claiming to make a good amount of of profit by investing in Bitcoin. A company by the name of Bitcoin Investment and Binary Trading has made an account on Telegram and claim to make a huge amount of profit for you. Their spokesperson by the name of Deuroth Loretta was contacted by myself and then the saga began. this person made me purchase bitcoin worth $500 and send it to the company address mentioned above. then she asked me to return after 2 hours to check my profit. when the time arrived to claim my profit she asked me for another $500 as mining fees. This was not cleared out before the begining of this conversation and then after getting the bitcoin a mining fee was demanded. they were not even willing to deduct the mining fees from the profit. They only demanded for another $500. Again when asked to refund the origional amount, a reversal fee of $150 was demanded. Again Deuroth refused to deduct the sum from the initial deposit. After this incident I knew that I had been scammed and refused to pay any more money. The company tried contacting me via email to peruade me to make more payments but I refused. 
The purpose of this complaint is to bring awareness for others not to be scammed by these fraudulent companies and people._x000D_
Thanks and regards.

reports.description: In June 2021, I came into contact with the platform named GeniusIG after signing up based on a Facebook ad  I saw. I was called by his first of three account managers, an individual named Nathan Logan, who persuaded me into making the initial deposit into the platform on the 15th of June. The following day, I was told that this was simply a registration fee and that I had to deposit more. My trading experience with the platform consisted of him giving access to my computer via AnyDesk. I got transferred to Ben. I  was told that he had an undisclosed and hidden balance of 4 BTC as they were trading on me behalf in a larger capacity than what was disclosed to me. I claims that this was a refuse from Ben in an attempt to get more money out of me. I was contacted by another account manager named Nick. Nick instructed the me to give him access to his phone via AnyDesk. but then intentionally opened positions that led to the loss of most of my balance. I was then told that they could no longer process my withdrawal due to my balance being low. I was then told that he should deposit more money to recover what was lost. I refused and told them he had no money. Since then, the I have not heard from the platform or its employees.
